Panchadhara and Saravara akhyapura. These temples belongs to Yalamanchili
Chalukhyas who descendants of Vengi Chalukhyans.

My self, AD. Mines and Geology, Anakapalli and Officers of Pollution board together
visited the mining site and it is situated about 1000 meters far form this Protected
monument called Panchadarla group of temples. Though the mining site is situated
beyond Regulated area i.e. 300 meters, The vibrations and Mining activities at this
hill may cause to damage the five water channels of Protected Monument,
Panchadarla group of temples. These five Channels collecting water from this
huge and lengthy hill. and we don't know the origin of this water source exactly
i.e. where it starts from the hill. This report is submitted for your kind perusal.

## Thanking you Madam,

Enclosed : G.O. Copy

Yours Faithfully

ROTTA PHALGUNA RAO

ASSISTANT DIRECTOR (TECH)

Copy to

Assistant Director, Mines & Geology, AKP.
